## Module 6 Lab: XGBoost {.smaller}

```{r data_prep}
#| echo: false
aus_wine <- read_csv(
  here::here("data/AustralianWines.csv"),
  na = "*",
  col_types = cols(Rose = col_number()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  fill(Rose, .direction = "down") |>
  mutate(Month = mdy(str_replace(Month, '-', '-01-')))

wines_ts <- aus_wine |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -Month, names_to = 'Varietal', values_to = 'Sales') |>
  mutate(Month = yearmonth(Month)) |>
  as_tsibble(index = Month, key = Varietal)

wines_ts |>
  autoplot(Sales) +
  labs(
    title = "Australian Wine Sales",
    y = "Sales (thousands of liters)"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Varietal, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") # hide legend
```

XGBoost[@chen2016xgboost] is an efficient and scalable implementation of the [gradient boosting]{.underline} framework. It has gained popularity for its performance in machine learning competitions and is widely used for structured/tabular data.

We will use caret to fit an XGBoost model wine series to predict 1994 for all varietals and compare to ARIMA results.


## XGBoost Model Implementation


```{r}
#| output-location: column
#| warning: true
library(caret)
```
```{r}
#| output-location: column
#| warning: true
library(xgboost)
```


## Build in autoregression and rolling features {.smaller}

```{r feature_engineering}
build_features <- function(ts_data) {
  ts_data |>
    as_tibble() |>
    arrange(Varietal, Month) |>
    group_by(Varietal) |>
    mutate(
      # Time-based features
      month_num = month(Month),
      year = year(Month),
      quarter = quarter(Month),
      # Lag features
      lag_1 = lag(Sales, 1),
      lag_2 = lag(Sales, 2),
      lag_3 = lag(Sales, 3),
      lag_12 = lag(Sales, 12),
      # Rolling averages
      ma_3 = slider::slide_dbl(Sales, mean, .before = 2, .complete = TRUE),
      ma_12 = slider::slide_dbl(Sales, mean, .before = 11, .complete = TRUE),
      # Trend feature
      time_trend = row_number()
    ) |>
    ungroup()
}

```

## Setup training and test data for caret {.smaller}

```{r data_prep_caret}
# Prepare data for caret
prepare_caret_data <- function(ts_data, is_test = FALSE, train_data = NULL) {
  result <- build_features(ts_data)

  if (!is_test) {
    # Training data: convert Varietal to factor and remove Month
    result <- result |>
      mutate(Varietal = factor(Varietal)) |>
      select(-Month) |>
      drop_na()
  } else {
    if (!is.null(train_data)) {
      # Get last 12 months from training data
      last_train <- train_data |>
        as_tibble() |>
        arrange(Varietal, Month) |>
        group_by(Varietal) |>
        slice_tail(n = 12) |>
        ungroup()

      # Combine and recalculate features
      combined <- bind_rows(last_train, ts_data) |>
        build_features() |>
        filter(Month >= yearmonth('1994 Jan')) |>
        # Let caret handle the factor automatically
        mutate(Varietal = factor(Varietal)) |>
        select(-Month)

      result <- combined
    }
  }
  result |> as_tibble()
}
```

## Prepare training and test datasets {.smaller}
```{r data_split}
# Prepare training data
tic("Caret XGBoost Data Prep")
train_data <- wines_ts |>
  filter(Month < yearmonth('1994 Jan'))
prepped_train_data <- train_data |>
  prepare_caret_data(is_test = FALSE)

# Prepare test data
prepped_test_data <- wines_ts |>
  filter(Month >= yearmonth('1994 Jan')) |>
  prepare_caret_data(is_test = TRUE, train_data = train_data)
toc()
```
```{r view_data, echo=FALSE}
prepped_train_data |>
  DT::datatable(
    options = list(
      initComplete = DT::JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "$(this.api().table().container()).css('font-size', '10px');",
        "}"
      )
    )
  )
```

## Train XGBoost model with caret {.smaller}

```{r model_training}

# Set up training control
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 5,
  verboseIter = FALSE
)

# Define XGBoost parameters grid
xgb_grid <- expand.grid(
  nrounds = 100,
  max_depth = 6,
  eta = 0.3,
  gamma = 0,
  colsample_bytree = 1,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  subsample = 1
)

# Fit XGBoost model
tic("Caret XGBoost Model Training")
caret_xgb_model <- train(
  Sales ~ .,
  data = prepped_train_data,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = xgb_grid,
  verbose = FALSE
)
time_caret_fit <- toc()

```

## Forecast and evaluate accuracy {.smaller}
```{r predictions}
# Make predictions
tic("Caret XGBoost Predictions")
caret_predictions <- predict(caret_xgb_model, newdata = prepped_test_data)

# Combine predictions with test metadata
test_metadata <- wines_ts |>
  filter(Month >= yearmonth('1994 Jan')) |>
  select(Month, Varietal, Sales) |>
  as_tibble()

caret_results <- test_metadata |>
  mutate(predicted = caret_predictions)
time_caret_predict <- toc()

# Calculate accuracy by varietal
caret_accuracy <- caret_results |>
  group_by(Varietal) |>
  summarise(
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((Sales - predicted)^2)),
    MAE = mean(abs(Sales - predicted)),
    MAPE = mean(abs((Sales - predicted) / Sales)) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(MAPE)
```

## {.smaller} 
```{r accuracy_table}
make_gt <- function(df, header = "Accuracy Table") {
  df |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(header) |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(RMSE, MAE), decimals = 1) |>
    fmt_number(columns = MAPE, decimals = 2)
}

# Display accuracy table
xgboost_gt <- caret_accuracy |>
  arrange(Varietal) |>
  make_gt('Accuracy of Caret XGBoost Model')
xgboost_gt
```

## Visualize results  {.smaller}
```{r results_viz}  
#| output-location: column
#| figure-height: 5
# Convert back to tsibble format for analysis
xgboost_results <- caret_results |>
  select(-Sales) |> 
  rename(Sales = predicted) |>
  as_tsibble(index = Month, key = Varietal)

# Create comparison plot
wines_ts |>
  filter_index('1992 Jan' ~ '1994 Dec') |>
  autoplot(Sales) +
  autolayer(xgboost_results, Sales, size = 2, linestyle = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~Varietal, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") 
```

## Feature Importance {.smaller}
```{r feature_importance}
# Feature importance
feature_importance <- varImp(caret_xgb_model, scale = FALSE)
plot(feature_importance, top = 15, main = "Caret XGBoost Feature Importance")
```


## ARIMA comparison: {.smaller}

```{r}
# Fit log transformed ARIMA models
arima_gt <- wines_ts |>
  filter_index(. ~ '1993 Dec') |>
  model(ARIMA(Sales)) |>
  forecast(h = "1 year") |>
  accuracy(wines_ts) |>
  select(Varietal, RMSE, MAE, MAPE) |>
  arrange(Varietal) |>
  make_gt('Accuracy of auto-ARIMA Model') 

```
